slides.title: THE $18,000 CLAUSE
slides.body: One line I now put in every contract.

slides.title: I approved the work.
slides.body: They asked for the money back nine days later. Approval was a feeling. It was not a date.

slides.title: What it says
slides.body: Payment is due on delivery, not on approval.

slides.title: Why delivery wins
slides.body: Delivery is a date you can prove. Approval is a mood you cannot.

slides.title: Add a review window
slides.body: Five working days to raise changes. After that, the work is accepted.

slides.title: Name the file, not the feeling
slides.body: Delivery means the final files are in their folder. Write down which folder.

slides.title: The four lines
list: Delivery is the date files land
Five working days to raise changes
Silence after five days is acceptance

slides.title: Comment CONTRACT
slides.body: I will send you the full clause.
